basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Manchester, UK, passionate about ham radio and digital communication. I work as a systems analyst in a mid-sized tech firm and enjoy tinkering with Raspberry Pi projects during weekends. I'm married, and my spouse shares my interest in technology. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends, often while working on my latest DIY project. Not a fan of overly commercialized content, I prefer authentic and informative discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in the IT industry, I have honed my skills in systems analysis and network communication protocols. My passion for amateur radio started as a hobby during my university days, leading to self-taught proficiency in ham radio operations and digital modes.
